subject: SCIENCE
title: Animal Parts at Work
objective: Explain that animal body parts can support different functions.
introduction: The same kind of part may have different functions across species. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

All the parts that make up a person or animal.
The natural home of a plant or animal.
